title: The Gromov-Hausdorff Distance Between Consecutive Spheres
summary: We determine the Gromov-Hausdorff distance between consecutive unit round spheres equipped with their geodesic metrics. Put $ζ_n:=\arccos(-\tfrac{1}{n+1}),$ the common geodesic distance between distinct vertices of a regular simplex with $n+2$ vertices inscribed in $\mathbb{S}^n$. We prove that $$ d_{\mathrm{GH}}(\mathbb{S}^n,\mathbb{S}^{n+1})=\frac{ζ_n}{2} \qquad(n\geq1), $$ resolving a conjecture of Lim, Mémoli, and Smith. All cases $n\geq4$ were previously open.
